\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 239-242 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R247-first-pass-words-from-chapters-239-242}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for useful and dangerous.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to swallow, to chew, to smell, to stare, to search
  \item to push, to put out, to drive, to halt, to turn
  \item to bring up, to sow, to cultivate, to sweep, to wipe
  \item to complain, to compete, to try, to finish, to continue
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To swallow? (\textbf{\ur{نگلنا}}, \emph{nigalnā}.) To chew? (\textbf{\ur{چبانا}}, \emph{chabānā}.) To smell? (\textbf{\ur{سونگھنا}}, \emph{sūṅghnā}.) To stare? (\textbf{\ur{گھورنا}}, \emph{ghūrnā}.) To search? (\textbf{\ur{تلاش} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{talāsh karnā}.) To push? (\textbf{\ur{دھکیلنا}}, \emph{dhakelnā}.) To put out? (\textbf{\ur{بجھانا}}, \emph{bujhānā}.) To drive? (\textbf{\ur{چلانا}}, \emph{chalānā}.) To halt? (\textbf{\ur{رکنا}}, \emph{ruknā}.) To turn? (\textbf{\ur{مڑنا}}, \emph{muṛnā}.) To bring up? (\textbf{\ur{پالنا}}, \emph{pālnā}.) To sow? (\textbf{\ur{بونا}}, \emph{bonā}.) To cultivate? (\textbf{\ur{اگانا}}, \emph{ugānā}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\ur{جھاڑو} \ur{لگانا}}, \emph{jhāṛū lagānā}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\ur{پونچھنا}}, \emph{ponchhnā}.) To complain? (\textbf{\ur{شکایت} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{shikāyat karnā}.) To compete? (\textbf{\ur{مقابلہ} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{muqābalā karnā}.) To try? (\textbf{\ur{کوشش} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{koshish karnā}.) To finish? (\textbf{\ur{ختم} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{khatm karnā}.) To continue? (\textbf{\ur{جاری} \ur{رکھنا}}, \emph{jārī rakhnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 243-247 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R247-second-pass-words-from-chapters-243-247}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for tiredness and strength.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item tiredness, strength, weight, height, a clinic
  \item a blister, a mark, a bandage, an ointment, a pharmacy
  \item the rainy season, daily, nowadays, at last; the end, a birthday
  \item a garage, everywhere, ahead, a border, a government
  \item short, possible, impossible, useful, dangerous
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Tiredness? (\textbf{\ur{تھکن}}, \emph{thakan}.) Strength? (\textbf{\ur{طاقت}}, \emph{tāqat}.) Weight? (\textbf{\ur{وزن}}, \emph{vazan}.) Height? (\textbf{\ur{قد}}, \emph{qad}.) A clinic? (\textbf{\ur{کلینک}}, \emph{klinik}.) A blister? (\textbf{\ur{چھالا}}, \emph{chhālā}.) A mark? (\textbf{\ur{نشان}}, \emph{nishān}.) A bandage? (\textbf{\ur{پٹی}}, \emph{paṭṭī}.) An ointment? (\textbf{\ur{مرہم}}, \emph{marham}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{\ur{دوا} \ur{خانہ}}, \emph{davā khānā}.) The rainy season? (\textbf{\ur{برسات}}, \emph{barsāt}.) Daily? (\textbf{\ur{روزانہ}}, \emph{rozānā}.) Nowadays? (\textbf{\ur{آج} \ur{کل}}, \emph{āj kal}.) At last; the end? (\textbf{\ur{آخر}}, \emph{ākhir}.) A birthday? (\textbf{\ur{سالگرہ}}, \emph{sālgirah}.) A garage? (\textbf{\ur{گیراج}}, \emph{garāj}.) Everywhere? (\textbf{\ur{ہر} \ur{جگہ}}, \emph{har jagah}.) Ahead? (\textbf{\ur{آگے}}, \emph{āge}.) A border? (\textbf{\ur{سرحد}}, \emph{sarhad}.) A government? (\textbf{\ur{حکومت}}, \emph{hukūmat}.) Short? (\textbf{\ur{ناٹا}}, \emph{nāṭā}.) Possible? (\textbf{\ur{ممکن}}, \emph{mumkin}.) Impossible? (\textbf{\ur{ناممکن}}, \emph{nāmumkin}.) Useful? (\textbf{\ur{مفید}}, \emph{mufīd}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\ur{خطرناک}}, \emph{khatarnāk}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
